title.narrative: Assisting Local Authorities and Women CSOs with Urban Evidence on Gender Inequalities
Assisting Local Authorities and Women CSOs with Urban Evidence on Gender Inequalities

description.narrative: The project aims to highlight gender inequalities in Istanbul. TESEV will produce an interactive map with information on inequalities at the neighborhood level. The map will then be used as a starting point for discussions between municipalities and women's organizations. The ambition is to find solutions to the gender inequalities that currently exist in Turkey.
